priorityList: Use Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally aligning with Zenith availability.
Cast Zenith when Xuen is active or during Bloodlust, ensuring Rising Sun Kick is on cooldown before casting.
Use Celestial Conduit while the Zenith buff is active, specifically when Rising Sun Kick, Fists of Fury, and Strike of the Windlord are all on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury immediately if the Heart of the Jade Serpent buff is about to expire to maximize value.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch on cooldown whenever available (requires Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Zenith or Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs are active.
Use Fists of Fury on cooldown as your primary AoE damage dealer and Chi spender.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Use Rising Sun Kick on cooldown if there are 5 or fewer targets or to enable Whirling Dragon Punch usage.
Use Spinning Crane Kick whenever a Dance of Chi-Ji proc is active.
Use Touch of Death to snipe low-health targets or if the Zenith buff is not active.
Cast Blackout Kick to spend Chi when Zenith is active and Fists of Fury is on cooldown, or to consume Combo Breaker procs.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi if you are below 5 Chi and nearing maximum Energy, always maintaining your Mastery combo.
Use Spinning Crane Kick as a filler in AoE (3+ targets) if you have excess Chi and major abilities are on cooldown.
Activate racial damage buffs (like Berserking or Blood Fury) when Xuen is active or during a Zenith window.
